∃ K S x x R entry exit C,
  ∀ {x : List Bool} (d : Turing.Cfg (K + 1) Bool S x),
    d.state = some entry →
      d.inputPos = 1 →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑x.length.bits.length → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = none) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)), j ≠ 0 → ∀ (p : ℤ), d.workTapes j p = none) →
            ∃ t ≤ C * (x.length + 1),
              (∀ u < t, (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
                (∀ u ≤ t,
                    ∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)),
                      |(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
                        ↑(C * (x.length.bits.length + 1))) ∧
                  Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                    { state := some exit, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                      workTapes := fun j q =>
                        if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑x.length.bits.length then
                          Turing.FinTM.bufferTape x.length.bits (q - d.workTapePos j)
                        else d.workTapes j q,
                      workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output }
